correctness.rationale: For every unlike adjacent color exchange the four-site Hamiltonian increment is an exact indicator identity. Positivity is equivalent to three explicit conditions, which force and characterize the long-domain/singleton patterns. Marking long domains gives the colored-cycle factor C_k=(q-1)^k+(q-1)(-1)^k and the rational logarithmic derivative. Its unique dominant positive pole gives the entropy and singleton density by implicit differentiation. Independent direct-Hamiltonian, domain, and Newton-sum checks agreed on all 180008 tested configurations (q=2 n=3..11; q=3 n=3..10; q=4 n=3..8). Finite tests are not the proof.

value.rationale: Exactly counting strict frozen configurations is a natural nonequilibrium invariant. The proved classification reveals an actual multicolor-only stable singleton-domain mechanism, yields a complete q-dependent finite-volume polynomial and nontrivial cubic growth rate, and quantifies its positive macroscopic singleton density. The distinction from q=2 and from dynamically selected state statistics is substantive rather than a routine small-size enumeration.
